summary: Iter 212m-156 — Mobile dashboard drawer browser-driven verification on PREVIEW (https://launch-pad-237.preview.emergentagent.com) at 390x844 (iPhone 14). All 8 acceptance scenarios PASS. Verified drawer state via CSS transform matrix + bounding box (not just is_visible(), which gave a false-positive 'visible' for an off-screen translated element).

issues: Tapping [data-testid='ds2-sidebar-avatar'] inside the drawer on mobile does NOT open a dropdown menu (0 [role='menuitem'] elements appear). Instead the click bubbles into a direct navigation to /settings. The drawer DOES auto-close correctly as part of that navigation, so the acceptance criterion is met, but the founder asked for 'avatar → dropdown → Settings (or Recharge/Logout)' which implies a menu. On mobile the dropdown affordance is absent — users cannot reach Recharge or Logout from the drawer avatar, only Settings. NON-BLOCKING for the iter 212m-156 fix itself; flag for product.

action_items: Consider: on mobile, the drawer avatar [data-testid='ds2-sidebar-avatar'] navigates directly to /settings instead of expanding a Settings/Recharge/Logout dropdown. Users have no in-drawer affordance for Recharge or Logout. Not in scope for iter 212m-156 but worth a follow-up.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx is ~708 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap. Consider extracting the mobile drawer wiring (hamburger button + backdrop + isMobile media-query effect) into a tiny <MobileSidebarShell> wrapper to keep the page slim.

The drawer-close on action relies on SidebarReal calling onAfterAction(). Repo-card click, Add-Repo click, tool-icon click, and avatar click ALL appear to trigger it correctly (verified via CSS transform returning to translateX(-280px)). No regression observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile drawer is FULLY functional on PREVIEW at 390x844. Selectors used: [data-testid='mobile-sidebar-toggle'] (hamburger), [data-testid='ds2-sidebar-wrap'] (drawer, transform-translateX controlled — DO NOT rely on Playwright is_visible() here, instead read computed transform OR bounding_box().x; closed = -280, open = 0), [data-testid='mobile-sidebar-backdrop'] (backdrop, only present in DOM when open). Desktop 1440x900 has zero hamburger/backdrop in DOM as expected. Tool buttons inside drawer (e.g. [data-testid='ds2-tool-health']) report 'outside of viewport' to Playwright's normal .click() because the drawer is fixed-position with overflow; use element.evaluate('e => e.click()') or scroll the drawer's internal scroller instead.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. The earlier Playwright run flagged Tests 4/5 as failures because is_visible() returns True for elements that are still in the layout flow but visually translated off-screen via transform: translateX(-280px). Second pass that asserted on getComputedStyle(el).transform AND el.getBoundingClientRect().x confirmed the drawer correctly slides closed (x=-280) on every required trigger: backdrop tap, Add-Repo click, tool-icon click, avatar click → /settings nav. Networking clean (0 × 4xx/5xx). Console clean (only React-Router v7 future-flag warnings, pre-existing).
